ipa.surfaces.eti.EtiSurfaceDefinition

The definition of the volatility surface.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.surfaces.eti.EtiSurfaceDefinition.

Syntax

EtiSurfaceDefinition(
    *,
    instrument_code: OptStr = None,
    clean_instrument_code: OptStr = None,
    exchange: OptStr = None,
    is_future_underlying: OptBool = None,
    is_lme_future_underlying: OptBool = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
instrument_code OptStr No None The code (ric for equities and indices and ricroot for futures.) that represents the instrument. the format for equities and indices is xxx@ric (example: vod.l@ric) the format for futures is xx@ricroot (example: cl@ricroot)
clean_instrument_code OptStr No None
exchange OptStr No None Specifies the exchange to be used to retrieve the underlying data.
is_future_underlying OptBool No None
is_lme_future_underlying OptBool No None
